description: Holds mpds quarterly review details records, linked to mpds quarterly review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report mpds quarterly review details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: headerid
columns.description: Reference to the mpds quarterly review header linked to this mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: acheived
columns.description: Acheived of the mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: percentage
columns.description: Percentage of the mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: MPDSQuarterlyReviewHeaderid
columns.description: MPDS quarterly review headerid of the mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: goal_masterId
columns.description: Goal master id of the mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: weightage
columns.description: Weightage of the mpds quarterly review detail.

columns.name: target
columns.description: Target of the mpds quarterly review detail.

relationships.description: Each mpds quarterly review detail references one mpds quarterly review header (header).

business_rules: Use acheived / percentage for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to MPDS Quarterly Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Acheived per mpds quarterly review detail

common_queries: MPDS Quarterly Review Details by mpds quarterly review header
Top mpds quarterly review header by acheived

known_issues: acheived, percentage, weightage, target are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
The table appeared empty (estimated 0 rows) when the metadata was last read.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name MPDSQuarterlyReviewDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting mpds quarterly review detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(acheived) for totals of acheived.
To resolve names, join on: headerid = MPDSQuarterlyReviewHeader.id.
